messages:
maria: Quick ask  we need a compact badge kit for the launch next week — badges used across slides, webinar footer, and social thumbnails. Core topics: latency, cost, reliability, multi-deploy. Also two certification badges. Can design take this?

kevin: Yup. Can you list exact badges, copy length, and hard brand rules?

maria: Badges: Latency (spark), Cost (coin/down arrow), Reliability (shield), Multi-deploy (globe). Certs: 'Redwood Verified' and 'SLA-ready'. Copy: 1-word headline + 1 short caption (2 words). Provide two caption variants.

tess: Brand rules: primary palette only, system type only, no decorative gradients, keep text contrast >= 4.5:1. See brand doc link.

kevin: Exports requested? SVG + PN G sizes? transparent bg?

nora: SVG masters plus PNGs: 800x800, 400x400, 200x200, banner 1200x300, favicon 32x32. Transparent bg. Include inverted and light treatments.

sam: For ads we need three color variants and two CTA overlays: 'Try Hosted' and 'Bring Private'. Also provide two alt-text strings per badge.

kevin: Plan: sketches today, vectors tomorrow am, full export Thu EOD. I'll upload a Figma file and a small preview slide.

figma-bot: Figma file created by kevin: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi789/mini-badge-kit 
kevin: Production notes: naming badge_<name>_<treatment>_<size>.[svg|png], manifest.csv listing alt-text and treatments. Will ping when comps ready for review.

maria: Thanks team  prioritize banner slice + SVGs so we can finish webinar slides. :thumbsup:
